and chop it into 250+ pieces

each piece will grow an entirely new body

and a new brain

you know...before you cut it up into 250 pieces. 

all 250 planarian will remember what you trained the original. 

<><><><>

what does it tell us about what they are not?

- well, perhaps for one, memory is a non-local phenomenon. 
- and consciousness is thereby nonlocal as well
